This episode is commonly identified as important in his decision to pursue filmmaking.',hot:[['01 · THE STREET','Our rain-soaked street is fictional art direction. It suggests how everyday surroundings can carry strong emotional meaning.'],['02 · THE CINEMA','Ray’s account of seeing Bicycle Thieves during his London visit is documented; the cinema façade seen here is invented.'],['03 · THE VIEWER','Instead of depicting Ray without evidence, this anonymous silhouette invites you to imagine the act of coming to cinema as a student.']],wide:'Establishing the street first can turn the cinema into a destination, building anticipation of what awaits inside.',detail:'Beginning with the entrance creates an immediate question: what experience is about to change the viewer?'},
